report.answer: Yes on this Linux worktree for the emitted scripts under command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0192/emitted/. Each file has cr_count=0 and real `bash -n` exit 0. `.gitattributes` pins `*.sh eol=lf`. A planted CRLF `if/then` fixture fails real bash -n (exit 2) while the Git-Bash igncr analogue (strip-CR then bash -n) exits 0, so the two detectors differ. A genuinely broken script fails both, so the analogue is not vacuous. git cat-file -p is used when the blob exists; otherwise worktree bytes. git archive is not used. windows-shell.md:3 is the regression seed. Catalog WSL is native Linux bash here (wsl_present=False). A second Windows shell (pwsh7 / Git Bash.exe) was not available and is not claimed. SUCCESS:TST-0192
